why: Two newsletters covering the same funding round must collapse into one news item. This is the dedup case the 'one call per source item against the in-prompt window' design exists for. The two headlines differ in case, punctuation, and word order only — which is as much as the deterministic fake can be expected to see through. Wording differences ('raises' vs 'raised') are the real adapter's job, and belong in a fixture added alongside it.
